His misjudgment — acting on the suspicion of his advisors rather than accepting David's genuine condolence — stands as a cautionary tale about political mistrust. Two other men named Hanun appear among Nehemiah's wall-builders: one repaired the Valley Gate (Neh 3:13) and another (possibly the same person) repaired a section near the armory (Neh 3:30). Spanish 'Hanún' and English 'Hanun' transliterate directly."
